items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I got the job, incidently, and I worked with him about six months before I told him who I was.

ctx.x: MS. WILLARD: Interview with John Collins. April 21, 1975. Do you want to proceed chronologically, start with the beginning in Montgomery, Alabama, your earliest musical influences.

Yes. Well, my mother was a very good pianist, and my grandmother was a very good pianist, and they taught music, played. My mother was something else though. And she also worked at this particular time real early, and when I was very small she worked for W. C. Handy, as a demonstration pianist. She and Fletcher Henderson. So I was always exposed to just about the best there was in music.
